releaseNotes: 1.2.0.6: currentApp now follows the last app that actually played. When an app closes or the TV turns off, the Apple TV can fall back to an older paused app (PBS showing up after watching Channels, for example). That paused app no longer takes over; only an app that starts playing does. If the app you were watching closes completely, it stays shown as stopped. 1.2.0.5: the Apple TV cards on the app page now update live, no page refresh needed. 1.2.0.4: after an update, each Apple TV reconnects on its own (before, it could look connected but stop updating until Reconnect). First beta: Shows which app is playing on each Apple TV and whether it's playing or paused, plus the title when the app shares it, and whether the TV is awake. Separate from Apple TV Integration and doesn't change it. After installing, open Integrations, add Apple TV Now Playing (Beta), and pair each TV with the PIN shown on screen.
author: jdthomas24

apps.name: Apple TV Now Playing (Beta)
apps.description: Finds and pairs Apple TVs and creates one Now Playing device per TV.

drivers.name: Apple TV Now Playing (Beta)
drivers.description: One device per Apple TV: current app, playback state, title and awake/asleep. Also runs its two hidden helper devices.
